200.description: Restored. `token`/`user` only when `admin` was given for a zip; `counts` for a zip, `media` for a dump.

hasPassword.description: False for SSO-only accounts, which have no local password to change.

pushOnChitchat.description: Push notifications for new chat messages (email variant not supported).

pushOnStory.description:
Push notifications for other members' new stories — off by default,
at most one per author per group per day (email variant not supported).

pushOnGiftList.description:
Push notifications for gift lists (`gift_list_invite`, `gift_draw`,
`gift_list_updated`) — on by default (email variant not supported).

counts.description: Restored rows per table, plus `files` (from the zip) and `mirroredFiles` (copied from the mirror)

media.description: Media copied back from the backups volume's mirror, or `null` when copying failed (the database is restored either way; see the server log)

400.description: Not a backup in the volume, not a valid Famlin backup, made by a newer Famlin version, media missing (`missingMedia`), or account fields required (`code` is `restoreAdminRequired`)

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).

409.description: The server already has accounts, or setup or another restore is in progress

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).

500.description: A dump restore failed (details only in the server log)

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).
